description: Send feedback to the people who build this product (not the user's organization, crew, or clients). It carries bug reports, feature suggestions, support questions, and praise, plus problems with these tools that the user agreed to report, and contains only what the user asked or agreed to send. It creates a Linear issue for the product team (email fallback if Linear is unavailable); it does not message anyone in the user's organization (the messaging tools do that). No sign-in needed. Add the user's email only if they want a reply.

category.description: IDEA = feature request or suggestion, PROBLEM = bug or something confusing, QUESTION = ask Soundcheck support, PRAISE = something that works well

email.description: where the team can reply; present only when the user agreed to share it and wants a reply

message.description: the feedback in the user's own words, with enough detail to act on: what they tried, what happened, and what they expected

name.description: who is sending the feedback, if they say

name: send_feedback

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Send feedback to Soundcheck
